gaps.explanation: No business-type revenue is in detail[]: the all-funds budget schedule p9 prints receipts only combined across governmental and utility funds, so only its utility disbursement lines (Electric Utility 801,585, Solid Waste 68,360, Wastewater 96,368, Water 78,980 = 1,045,293) were recorded. The proprietary statement p6 (operating revenues) and p8 (nonoperating revenues) print the revenue per fund column: Electricity 938,752 + 1,276 + 4,585 + interest 22,568 = 967,181; Water 146,123 + 342 = 146,465; Sewer 86,679 + 150 = 86,829; Solid Waste 84,680 + 846 = 85,526; Solid Waste Closure/Postclosure Care interest 3. Sum 1,286,004 = statement total (operating 1,263,433 + nonoperating 22,571). Schedule 0 + added 1,286,004 = 1,286,004, exact.
